name: Treadmill high angle POV walking selfie
summary: High-angle downward POV selfie taken while walking on a treadmill in a commercial gym: dark cardio bay, console handles and moving belt visible, headphones on, subject looking down.

colors.white_balance: cool neutral mixed with dim gym downlights
colors.contrast: medium — matte dark tones of treadmill console against skin
notable_casts: slight grey-blue tint from digital console backlights

lighting.hardness: soft overhead with direct high-angle shadows under chin
artifacts: motion softness on belt and moving hands
mild sensor noise in dark clothing folds

camera.angle: steep high-angle downward selfie angle (~45 degrees)
camera.depth_of_field: shallow to moderate — chest, face, and headphones in focus, treadmill belt falling softly out of focus

composition.framing: bust/chest up looking down, treadmill dashboard cutting across mid-lower frame
composition.tilt: slight casual tilt from single-handed phone hold
composition.foreground: treadmill handlebars, heart rate sensors, walking belt
composition.background: dim commercial cardio zone with out-of-focus machines in background
composition.negative_space: dark upper corners and machine base
composition.reflections: faint reflection in treadmill monitor screen

subject_treatment.pose_type: active walking on treadmill, one arm holding camera high, one arm relaxed at side
subject_treatment.face_visibility: mostly visible looking down at screen/steps, forehead and hair in view
subject_treatment.gaze: downward toward phone screen or treadmill track
subject_treatment.wardrobe_category: casual workout tank top or oversized t-shirt, athletic shorts

environment: busy commercial cardio section with rows of treadmills and elliptical machines in moody gym interior
effects_imperfections: handheld slight camera shake / motion micro-blur
luminance noise in deep shadow areas of gym ceiling
sweat shine and wisps of stray hair from cardio exertion

typography_overlay.text_style: bold white sans-serif with subtle drop shadow

mood: in the zone, daily grind, cardio endurance, candid authenticity
reusable_prompt_fragment: high-angle downward POV selfie walking on commercial treadmill, treadmill handles and belt below, dark cardio area with dim overhead downlights, wearing over-ear headphones and tank top, slight handheld motion blur, realistic sweat sheen and stray hair, authentic daily workout grind
excerlock_fit: work slide / cardio session proof — captures authentic physical effort in progress
